summary: This is a foreign private issuer's form 6-K furnishing a notice of an extraordinary general meeting to approve a reverse share consolidation at a ratio between 10:1 and 30:1, as a routine capital restructuring to maintain listing compliance, not a special situation. The board recommends the proposal, with the exact ratio and effective date to be set later, no later than July 11, 2026. There is no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other transformative event described. The filing is a purely administrative corporate action with no special-situation catalyst.
